_comment: Authored Stormwood macro geography, baked offline. Region lattice is 512 m; 9 by 12 regions. Noise supplies surface variation only; settlements, passes and the Glass Sink have fixed positions.
_comment_settlement_pads: Measured 2026-09-09 against the shipped Terrain3D data and the real imported prefab AABBs/colliders. The old lowest-of-five placement put 0.39-3.22m of terrain above walkable floors (Rodline workshop worst 3.22m; Lantern inn 0.93m; Lantern workshop 0.96m). Each pad covers the building's ground-touching collider footprint plus its 3m local-+Z doorway/open-arch approach. Height is the measured footprint mid-relief, balancing cut and fill instead of lifting the building onto the highest corner. The 10m smooth blend returns to the unchanged macro landform outside. NPCs, paths, camps and village placement all query this same heightfield, so their terrain agreement is preserved. Decorative carts and wells retain natural relief; Crown's well already measured exactly flat.
_collision_comment: Full game collision supports geographically separated peers in one realm; measure memory and CPU before accepting the world. Never average two players into one collision focus.
